thumbnail.alt: A police officer listens calmly to a student organiser holding a memorandum at a peaceful march on a city street.
An officer at a police station front desk listens attentively to a worried resident reporting a stolen phone.
Two officers listen calmly at an apartment doorway in the evening while a concerned resident stands nearby.
An officer at a help desk calmly reviews messages on a shop owner's phone while taking notes.
A police officer calmly directs traffic at a city junction after a minor two-wheeler and van collision as an ambulance approaches.
Two students compare a sunlit puddle with a shaded one under a tree on a school playground after rain.
Students build a layered sand-and-gravel filter to clear muddy water in a school science classroom.
Students in goggles add indicator drops to three beakers and watch the colours change in a school lab.
A student committee compares snack packs and works out a budget at a school canteen table.
Three students study a hand-drawn library map together while searching for a missing book.
A student picks up a dropped wrapper during recess and looks toward an overflowing school bin.
A student kindly approaches a quiet new classmate sitting alone at lunch, leaving them space to choose.
A student pauses before forwarding an alarming group message and checks an official source on a second screen.
A student on a school-morning pavement points friends toward the pedestrian crossing instead of crossing between cars.
A student calmly mediates between two groups of players after a disputed run-out in a school cricket match.
Two students examine rust on a school gate and compare metal test strips for their investigation.
A student energy team reads the school meter and studies usage charts beside an empty classroom with fans running.
Students observe a neighbourhood pond after heavy rain, noting runoff and algae as they investigate.
Students interview a classmate to make their school survey more inclusive.
Students with umbrellas study a map and a blocked drain beside a flooded crossroads during the monsoon.
Students talk with a shopkeeper and a sanitation worker on a street where litter has returned after a clean-up.
Two students pause to check the source of a viral video on a phone instead of sharing it.
Four students around a project table work out a fair plan to finish their group assignment.
A student pauses to consider a headphone purchase beside a closed coin purse and face-down phone.
A student studying the night before an exam turns away from a phone buzzing with a leaked-paper rumour.
Senior students in a chemistry lab compare cleaned and stained glassware to test two cleaning products.
A student energy team measures a school rooftop beside solar panels while reviewing a generation chart.
Senior students compare groups of coloured counters to reason about changes in a bacterial population.
Two students examine gaps in paper records and question a proposed conclusion.
A senior student compares an old newspaper, a report, a photograph and oral-history recordings for a heritage exhibition.
Students distribute counters across separate trays while discussing diversification.
A student in a small rented room plans a first monthly budget with a notebook and phone.
Students discuss waste separation with a shopkeeper and sanitation worker beside market bins.
A student supports a worried friend and reports a fake video rather than reposting it.
A student team rearranges the programme the night before a school festival, with an accessible stage behind them.
